Acme: Total delivered price USD 37,550.00

Orbital: Quote shows unit price 760, quantity 50 => 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units => 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So discounted total 36,480. Shipping included. Total delivered 36,480.00

BrightPath: Total delivered price 35,750.00

Nimbus: Unit price 728, quantity 50 => 36,400. Shipping 300 => 36,700. Total delivered 36,700.00

Thus cheapest is BrightPath with 35,750.00.
